# Hash-pinned install for the bashate linter used by bash-checks.yml.
#
# pip's --require-hashes mode demands that every requirement, including
# transitive ones, is pinned with == and carries a hash. bashate depends on
# pbr, and pbr on setuptools, which has no dependencies of its own, so the
# full tree is three entries. Both wheel and sdist hashes are listed so pip
# can satisfy either.
#
# Renovate does not currently watch this file. See the Pinned-Dependencies
# notes in CONTRIBUTING.md before bumping by hand.

bashate==2.1.1 \
    --hash=sha256:3104d565a7a0f7ee2cf4028cc584c723a202f52a8ddffe4a39b8cbb0ac5d3e94 \
    --hash=sha256:4bab6e977f8305a720535f8f93f1fb42c521fcbc4a6c2b3d3d7671f42f221f4c

pbr==7.1.3 \
    --hash=sha256:6583e878a1d97cb135fdc509811f31b9235905cde8d4dacd3dbadf9efc45d745 \
    --hash=sha256:9a4a85b84e906337708009af0b5f5cdabeeb72d4dc213c9e97974da54fd9acc5

setuptools==84.0.0 \
    --hash=sha256:51a52592b3b99e102b609654876bd65f19f999935166d1352678931132b0c670 \
    --hash=sha256:f4695c21257f0d9b537ec2692c941d02ee143b7cc1276941349a546573b2ef73
